title: Monster dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#9dff6b' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#9dff6b' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- glow aura -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='46' fill='url(#glow)' opacity='0.35'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='22' ry='20' fill='#5b2c9e'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='16' ry='13' fill='#7a44c9'/>
  <!-- left arm waving up -->
  <path d='M30 56 Q18 44 14 30' stroke='#5b2c9e' stroke-width='8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='13' cy='27' r='6' fill='#7a44c9'/>
  <!-- right arm out to side -->
  <path d='M70 58 Q82 54 90 46' stroke='#5b2c9e' stroke-width='8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='92' cy='44' r='6' fill='#7a44c9'/>
  <!-- left leg kicked -->
  <path d='M40 82 Q34 92 26 94' stroke='#5b2c9e' stroke-width='8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='23' cy='94' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#7a44c9'/>
  <!-- right leg planted -->
  <path d='M60 82 Q64 92 70 94' stroke='#5b2c9e' stroke-width='8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='73' cy='94' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#7a44c9'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='34' r='17' fill='#5b2c9e'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='34' r='12' fill='#7a44c9'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='32' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#ffe96b'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='32' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#ffe96b'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='33' r='2' fill='#2a1a45'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='33' r='2' fill='#2a1a45'/>
  <!-- big grin -->
  <path d='M40 40 Q50 50 60 40' stroke='#ffe96b' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- little fangs -->
  <path d='M44 43 L45 48 L47 44 Z' fill='#ffe96b'/>
  <path d='M53 44 L55 48 L56 43 Z' fill='#ffe96b'/>
  <!-- horns -->
  <path d='M38 22 Q34 12 40 10 Q40 18 44 20 Z' fill='#ff8fc4'/>
  <path d='M62 22 Q66 12 60 10 Q60 18 56 20 Z' fill='#ff8fc4'/>
  <!-- dancing sparkles -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='20' r='2' fill='#ffe96b'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='26' r='2' fill='#ffe96b'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='14' r='1.6' fill='#9dff6b'/>
</svg>
